gloss: to value; to cherish; to take good care of; to treasure

definitions.gloss: to cherish; to treasure; to value
definitions.explanation: To regard someone or something as precious and treat them accordingly. Used for relationships, memories, feelings, and abstract values.

definitions.gloss: to take good care of; to handle carefully
definitions.explanation: To treat a physical object or one's own health with care so as not to damage or lose it.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}を{大切|たいせつ}にする。
{友達|ともだち}との{時間|じかん}を{大切|たいせつ}にしたい。
examples.english: I want to treasure my time with friends.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{気持|きも}ちを{大切|たいせつ}にしながら、{相手|あいて}の{意見|いけん}も{尊重|そんちょう}するべきだ。
examples.english: You should respect the other person's opinion while also valuing your own feelings.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}は{大切|たいせつ}にしてね。
examples.english: Please take good care of this book.

examples.japanese: {体|からだ}を{大切|たいせつ}にしてください。
examples.english: Please take care of your health.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}からもらった{指輪|ゆびわ}を{大切|たいせつ}にしている。
examples.english: I treasure the ring I received from my grandmother.

notes:
One of the most common and versatile expressions in Japanese. お{体|からだ}を{大切|たいせつ}に or お{体|からだ}を{大切|たいせつ}にしてください is a standard parting phrase meaning "take care of yourself" — used when saying goodbye, especially when someone is unwell or in difficult circumstances.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人|ひと}を{大切|たいせつ}にする: to value people
- {命|いのち}を{大切|たいせつ}にする: to value life
- {時間|じかん}を{大切|たいせつ}にする: to value time
- {物|もの}を{大切|たいせつ}にする: to take good care of things
- お{体|からだ}を{大切|たいせつ}に: take care of yourself

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大事|だいじ}にする: to take care of; to treasure — very similar and largely interchangeable; slightly more casual
- {尊重|そんちょう}する: to respect — more formal; focuses on recognizing value or rights
- {愛|あい}する: to love — deeper emotional attachment; {大切|たいせつ}にする is broader and includes care without romantic love
